name: Maya R.
quote: The list is short. I used to buy thirty things and throw a third of it out by Thursday.

name: Devon K.
quote: I typed my budget and my protein on Sunday and the whole week was planned before the coffee was ready.

name: Priya S.
quote: The receipt reveal is the part I did not expect. You photograph the receipt and it shows the estimate right next to what you paid.

name: Tomás L.
quote: I sent my roommate the share card. He came back with his own week and now it is a thing we do.

name: Jordan W.
quote: Every meal shows the protein and the price on the same line. That is the whole reason I keep it open in the store.

name: Elena F.
quote: Seeing what the same list costs delivered from Kroger next to the shelf price made the walk to the store an easy call.
